policy.acceptance_requirements: any observable acceptance requirement that must be scored is a registered claim with an adapter; unregistered A5 requirements were dropped rather than promoted (see dropped_from_a5_execution_goal)
policy.fix_reproducer_command: A14-A6 types the already candidate-visible c05 reproducer argv as one CompletionContract fix command; goals and acceptance requirements are unchanged
policy.goal: one shared semantic goal component per case, identical for the current-product baseline and both candidate lanes; equals the corpus goal plus only the binding specifics that registered claims and adapters need
policy.host_tooling: playwright-core in offline_dependencies is frozen host-owned browser tooling copied outside candidate workspaces; it is not an allowed product dependency
policy.loader: goal_verify_task_contracts_v4.bind reads `goal` instead of `execution_goal`; candidate INPUT JSON keeps `goal` and `task_contract.operational_constraints` as separate fields, while baseline --plan-run receives a deterministic labeled envelope containing the same semantic goal and canonical operational_constraints JSON
policy.operational_constraints: typed, shared, candidate-visible, and not independently scored; candidates must not derive new claims from them, but may use them to bind oracles for already-provided required claim IDs; the conformance lane's exact registered claim ID set is unchanged

validation.completion_contract: must be an object whose required_paths are safe relative paths and whose verify_commands remain consistent with the semantic goal and registered claims
validation.fix_reproducer_command: optional single command normalized by the product verify policy; it must equal the candidate-visible operational_constraints.reproducer argv
validation.goal: must be a non-empty semantic goal component shared unchanged inside the baseline envelope and candidate INPUT JSON
validation.operational_constraints: must be an object with scored=false; paths must be safe workspace-relative strings; argv values must be non-empty direct argument arrays without shell syntax; allowed and forbidden dependency sets must not overlap
validation.readiness: all selected cases must pass these checks before contract freeze
validation.registered_claims: must exactly equal the corresponding corpus required claim ID set with no duplicates
validation.source_goal_sha256: must equal the SHA-256 of the corresponding corpus goal
validation.unknown_fields: rejected unless added to the preregistered v4_a9 task-registry validator
